document_title: Opinion and Order (adopting the joint stipulation and recommendation filed October 23, 2024, as modified herein)
how_obtained: Fetched the PDF over HTTPS from the Supreme Court of Ohio public docket document handler (pdf_viewer.aspx), then extracted the embedded text layer with PyMuPDF 1.26.5 page.get_text("text"), concatenating pages in order. No cleaning, reflowing, de-hyphenation, encoding repair or page markers were applied; marginal line numbers, running heads, Q/A markers and blank image-only (redacted) pages appear exactly as the extractor produced them. Entered in the Journal July 9, 2025. Filed into Supreme Court case 2025-1458 on 2025-11-03 as 'Agency decision (opinion and order)'.
publisher: Supreme Court of Ohio, Clerk of Court public docket (ECMS), case 2025-1458
access: public record; no login, no paywall; redacted public versions only
